ONTOLOGY:
- Concept [bsm:Concept]
    · name (data) [bsm:conceptName] — Primary name of the Concept. Mandatory in MIM.
  - Battlespace Concept [bsm:BattlespaceConcept]
      · alternate name (data) [bsm:alternateName] — An additional name by which the concept is known — aliases, callsigns, transponder-broadcast names, vessel AIS names.
      · additional information (data) [bsm:additionalInformationText] — Free-text additional information about the concept that does not fit any structured attribute.
      · hostility code (data) [bsm:hostilityCode] — Perceived hostility from following values (Friend, Hostile, Neutral, Suspect, Unknown, Pending, Assumed-Friend, Joker, Faker).
      · source identifier (data) [bsm:sourceIdentifier] — EXTENSION: the primary key or row identifier from the originating dataset that produced this concept instance, enabling traceability back to the source record.
      · has geographic location (obj) [bsm:hasGeographicLocation] — Position of the BattlespaceConcept, expressed as a Location (which in turn carries a Geometry).
      · has alternate identifier (obj) [bsm:hasAlternateIdentifier] — Attaches a structured AlternateIdentifier (scheme + value) to the BattlespaceConcept.
      · part of (obj) [bsm:partOf] — Indicates that an entity is a subpart of a higher concept, added initially for location hierarchy: City, Region, Country
    - Object [bsm:Object]
        · type name (data) [bsm:typeName] — Free-text name of the Object's type. Used for category strings that do not map to a closed MIM code list (e.g. vessel-type strings broadcast by maritime navigation systems, aircraft model designations).
        · has affiliation (obj) [bsm:hasAffiliation] — Geopolitical, ethnic, religious or other affiliation of the Object: captures flag-state of vessels, origin-country of aircraft, nationality of persons.
      - Actor [bsm:Actor] — A person or a group of persons able to perform actions.
          · operates materiel (obj) [bsm:operatesMateriel] — Mirrors mim:Actor.employedMateriel directly.
          · owns materiel (obj) [bsm:ownsMateriel] — Mirrors mim:Actor.ownedMateriel directly. Inverse of bsm:hasOwner.
          · has sanction designation (obj) [bsm:hasSanctionDesignation] — Attaches a SanctionDesignation to an Actor.
          · has controlled facility (obj) [bsm:hasControlledFacility] — Facility under the control of the Actor.
        - Person [bsm:Person] — A human being of military or civilian significance.
            · birth date (data) [bsm:birthDate] — Date of birth of the Person.
            · death date (data) [bsm:deathDate] — Date of death of the Person, if applicable.
            · gender code (data) [bsm:genderCode] — Gender of the Person. Backed by the MIM GenderCode enumeration.
            · military status code (data) [bsm:militaryStatusCode] — Whether the Person is civilian, military or paramilitary. Backed by the MIM PersonMilitaryStatusCode enumeration.
            · characteristic code (data) [bsm:characteristicCode] — Profession, social status or legal/military involvement of the Person. Backed by the MIM PersonCharacteristicCode enumeration.
            · duty status code (data) [bsm:dutyStatusCode] — Current duty status of the Person (active, on leave, retired, …).
            · is member of (obj) [bsm:isMemberOf] — Person is a formal member of the Organisation.
            · is assigned to (obj) [bsm:isAssignedTo] — Long-term assignment of a Person to an Organisation.
            · is attached to (obj) [bsm:isAttachedTo] — Temporary attachment of a Person to an Organisation.
            · has superior (obj) [bsm:hasSuperior] — Direct superior of the Person in a chain of command.
            · has subordinate (obj) [bsm:hasSubordinate] — Direct subordinate of the Person.
            · is operative of (obj) [bsm:isOperativeOf] — Person used as a secret or trusted agent of an Organisation.
            · has nationality (obj) [bsm:hasNationality] — Attaches a PersonNationality (country + reason) to the Person.
            · has identification document (obj) [bsm:hasIdentificationDocument] — Attaches an identification document held by the Person.
        - Organisation [bsm:Organisation] — An administrative or functional structure.
            · description (data) [bsm:descriptionText] — Free-text description of the Organisation.
            · main activity code (data) [bsm:mainActivityCode] — Primary activity sector of the Organisation. Like industry, NGO.
            · has member (obj) [bsm:hasMember] — Inverse of bsm:isMemberOf.
            · has assigned person (obj) [bsm:hasAssignedPerson] — Inverse of bsm:isAssignedTo.
      - Materiel [bsm:Materiel] — Superclass for military supplies, vehicles, and other tools
          · serial number (data) [bsm:serialNumberIdentifier] — Serial number assigned by the manufacturer or operator.
          · model name (data) [bsm:modelName] — Manufacturer's model designation.
          · is active (data) [bsm:isActiveIndicator] — True if the Materiel is currently active (in service).
          · has controller (obj) [bsm:hasController] — The Actor that has authority over the Materiel.
          · has operator (obj) [bsm:hasOperator] — The Actor that operates the Materiel (uses it in practice, distinct from owning or controlling).
          · has owner (obj) [bsm:hasOwner] — The Actor that owns the Materiel.
          · is on account of (obj) [bsm:isOnAccountOf] — The Actor that holds accounting authority over the Materiel.
          · transports actor (obj) [bsm:transportsActor] — The Materiel is responsible for movement of the Person.
          · is loaded on (obj) [bsm:isLoadedOn] — Materiel that is loaded onto another (carrying) Materiel. Mirrors mim:Materiel.loadedMateriel.
          · carries (obj) [bsm:carries] — Carrying Materiel. Mirrors mim:Materiel.carryingMateriel. Inverse of bsm:isLoadedOn.
        - ConsumableMateriel [bsm:ConsumableMateriel] — Consumable goods, food, ammunition, etc.
        - Equipment [bsm:Equipment] — Materiel that is neither intended for consumption nor an unexploded piece of ordnance.
            · has mobility (obj) [bsm:hasMobility] — Mobility characteristics of the Equipment.
          - Vehicle [bsm:Vehicle] — A conveyance for transporting persons or things. Common parent of Aircraft, Vessel and LandVehicle.
              · operating mode code (data) [bsm:operatingModeCode] — Operating mode of the Vehicle: manned, unmanned, autonomous, remotely piloted.
              · has observation (obj) [bsm:hasObservation]
            - Aircraft [bsm:Aircraft] — A Vehicle designed to fly within the earth's atmosphere.
                · design range code (data) [bsm:designRangeCode] — Range category of the Aircraft.
                · design role code (data) [bsm:designRoleCode] — Primary design role of the Aircraft (fighter, transport, surveillance, …).
                · type main purpose code (data) [bsm:typeMainPurposeCode] — Main purpose of the Aircraft type.
                · military/civilian code (data) [bsm:militaryCivilianCode] — Whether the Aircraft is military or civilian.
                · wing span (data) [bsm:wingSpanDimension] — Wing span of the Aircraft.
                · weapon type code (data) [bsm:weaponTypeCode] — Type of weapons the Aircraft is armed with.
            - Vessel [bsm:Vessel] — A Vehicle designed to operate on or under the water surface.
                · vessel category code (data) [bsm:vesselCategoryCode] — Category of the Vessel: cargo, tanker, fishing, passenger, military, special-craft.
                · vessel maximum speed (data) [bsm:vesselMaximumSpeed] — Maximum design speed of the Vessel. Mirrors mim:Vessel.maximumSpeed.
            - Land Vehicle [bsm:LandVehicle] — A vehicle designed to operate on the ground.
      - Facility [bsm:Facility] — An Object that is built, installed or established to serve a particular purpose and is identified by the service it provides rather than by its content.
          · facility is active (data) [bsm:facilityIsActiveIndicator] — True if the Facility is currently in active operation.
          · facility access restriction code (data) [bsm:facilityAccessRestrictionCode] — Access-restriction class for the Facility (e.g. unrestricted, restricted, prohibited).
        - Transport Facility [bsm:TransportFacility] — Facility supporting the movement of vehicles, persons or goods. Parent of air, maritime and ground transport facilities.
          - Maritime Transport Facility [bsm:MaritimeTransportFacility] — Maritime transport infrastructure — ports, harbours, piers, anchorages, naval bases.
            - Port [bsm:Port] — Civilian or commercial port. Mirrors mim:PortType.
            - Military Seaport or Naval Base [bsm:MilitarySeaportOrNavalBase] — Military seaport or naval base.
            - Harbour [bsm:Harbour] — Harbour
          - Air Transport Facility [bsm:AirTransportFacility] — Air transport infrastructure.
            - Airport or Airbase [bsm:AirportOrAirbase] — Civilian airport or military airbase.
        - Energy Facility [bsm:EnergyFacility] — Energy generation, transmission or storage infrastructure like power plants, substations, offshore wind farms, gas terminals.
        - Petroleum Production Complex [bsm:PetroleumProductionComplex] — Refineries, oil terminals and gas terminals.
    - Action [bsm:Action] — An activity (or the occurrence of one) that may use resources and may be focused against an objective. Used for conflict events, incidents, movements and aircraft activities.
        · action description (data) [bsm:actionDescriptionText] — Free-text description of the Action.
        · classification code (data) [bsm:classificationCode] — Classification of the Action.
        · event start time (data) [bsm:eventStartDateTime] — Event Start Timestamp
        · event end time (data) [bsm:eventEndDateTime] — Event End Timestamp
        · has focus (obj) [bsm:hasFocus] — ActionObjective the Action is directed at.
        · has requirement (obj) [bsm:hasRequirement] — ActionResource(s) required/requested/allocated by the Action.
        · has result (obj) [bsm:hasResult] — ActionEffect resulting from the Action, like fatalities, damage, casualties.
        · has sub-action (obj) [bsm:hasSubAction] — Sub-action of the Action.
        · is caused by (obj) [bsm:isCausedBy] — The subject Action is carried out in reaction to the object Action.
        · has response (obj) [bsm:hasResponse] — Inverse of bsm:isCausedBy.
        · involved actor (obj) [bsm:involvedActor] — EXTENSION: direct association between an Action and an involved Actor.
    - Location [bsm:Location] — A position and geometry with respect to a horizontal frame of reference and a vertical datum. The MIM-standard wrapper around a Geometry.
        · location name (data) [bsm:locationName] — Human-readable name of the Location.
        · has geometry (obj) [bsm:hasGeometry] — Geometry component of a Location
    - Action Effect [bsm:ActionEffect] — The effectiveness of an Action against an Object or type of Object: fatalities, casualties, damage, destruction.
        · effect description code (data) [bsm:effectDescriptionCode] — Type of outcome (Fatalities, Casualties, Damaged, Destroyed, …).
        · effect quantity (data) [bsm:effectQuantityNumber] — Aggregated count for the effect, e.g. number of fatalities. Mirrors mim:ActionEffect.quantityNumber.
        · effect severity code (data) [bsm:effectSeverityCode] — Severity grade of the effect.
        · effect on object (obj) [bsm:effectOnObject] — Object that the ActionEffect was observed on.
    - Action Resource [bsm:ActionResource] — An Object (or type of Object) used in conducting an Action.
        · resource object (obj) [bsm:resourceObject] — Bridge from ActionResource to the participating Object (actor or piece of materiel).
    - Action Objective [bsm:ActionObjective] — The intended focus of an Action.
        · targets object (obj) [bsm:targetsObject] — Bridge from ActionObjective to the targeted Object.
    - Sanction Designation [bsm:SanctionDesignation] [EXT] — EXTENSION: a formal designation/listing of an Actor under a sanctions, watch-list or debarment regime.
        · listing date (data) [bsm:listingDate] — Date on which the designation was issued.
        · delisting date (data) [bsm:delistingDate] — Date on which the designation was lifted, if applicable.
        · sanction reason (data) [bsm:sanctionReason] — Free-text reason for which the designation was made.
        · source URL (data) [bsm:sourceUrl] — URL pointing to the public listing document.
        · listing authority (obj) [bsm:listingAuthority] — Organisation that issued the sanction listing.
    - Observation [bsm:Observation] [EXT]
        · observation date time (data) [bsm:observationDateTime]
- Geometry [bsm:Geometry] — Measurements and relationships of points, lines, surfaces and volumes. Abstract parent of Point, Line, Surface in MIM.
  - Point [bsm:Point] — A zero-dimensional location.
    - Absolute Point [bsm:AbsolutePoint] — A Point with its position specified in WGS-84 latitude, longitude and vertical distance.
        · latitude (decimal degrees, WGS84) (data) [bsm:latitudeDecimal] — Latitude of the AbsolutePoint in decimal degrees.
        · longitude (decimal degrees, WGS84) (data) [bsm:longitudeDecimal] — Longitude of the AbsolutePoint in decimal degrees
  - Line [bsm:Line] — A one-dimensional location, ordered sequence of points.
  - Surface [bsm:Surface] — A two-dimensional location. Mirrors mim:SurfaceType.
- Velocity [bsm:Velocity] — The movement of an Object in terms of speed, course and inclination.
    · speed (m/s) (data) [bsm:speedMetersPerSecond] — Speed of the Object
    · absolute bearing angle (data) [bsm:absoluteBearingAngle] — Course over ground / track angle, degrees clockwise from true north.
    · inclination angle (data) [bsm:inclinationAngle] — Vertical inclination of the velocity vector, in degrees (positive climbing).
- Orientation [bsm:Orientation] — Inclination of the three principal axes of an Object (longitudinal, lateral, vertical) with respect to the geographic coordinate system.
    · heading angle (data) [bsm:headingAngle] — Heading (direction the longitudinal axis points), degrees true.
- Altitude [bsm:Altitude] [EXT] — Altitude of an object (Extension)
    · altitude in meters (data) [bsm:altitudeMeters] — Altitude of the object in meters.
- Affiliation [bsm:Affiliation] — Membership or allegiance to an ethnic group, country, functional group, exercise group or religion.
  - Geopolitical Affiliation [bsm:GeopoliticalAffiliation] [EXT] — Affiliation with a country or political entity: flag state of a vessel, country of registration of an aircraft, or the jurisdiction an actor is associated with.
      · geopolitical affiliation code (data) [bsm:geopoliticalAffiliationCode] — Country or political-entity code.
  - Ethnic Affiliation [bsm:EthnicAffiliation] [EXT] — Affiliation with an ethnic group.
      · ethnic group code (data) [bsm:affiliationEthnicGroupCode] — Ethnic group identifier.
  - Religious Affiliation [bsm:ReligiousAffiliation] [EXT] — Affiliation with a religion or religious community.
      · religion code (data) [bsm:affiliationReligionCode] — Religion identifier.
- Mobility [bsm:Mobility] — Description of the mobility characteristics of a unit or piece of equipment (terrain types, propulsion modes, range). Mirrors mim:MobilityType.
- Alternate Identifier [bsm:AlternateIdentifier] — The alternate identification of a BattlespaceConcept used to communicate using another standard.
    · alternate identifier standard code (data) [bsm:alternateIdentifierStandardCode] — The identifier authority/standard
    · alternate identifier value (data) [bsm:alternateIdentifierValue] — The identifier value itself, as a string.
- Person Nationality [bsm:PersonNationality] — A citizenship description for a Person
    · nationality country code (data) [bsm:nationalityCountryCode] — Country code of the Person's nationality. Backed by the MIM CountryCode enumeration.
    · nationality reason code (data) [bsm:nationalityReasonCode] — Reason for which the nationality is held (birth, naturalisation, marriage, …).
- Person Identification Document [bsm:PersonIdentificationDocument] — A formal identification document held by a Person like passport, national ID, driver's licence, etc.
    · ID document category (data) [bsm:identificationDocumentCategoryCode] — Type of identification document (passport, national ID card, driver's licence, …).
    · ID document number (data) [bsm:identificationDocumentIdentifier] — Reference number on the identification document.
- (unattached: no declared domain class)
    · has velocity (obj) [bsm:hasVelocity] — Current velocity vector of the Object.
    · has orientation (obj) [bsm:hasOrientation] — Current orientation of the Object's principal axes.
    · has altitude (obj) [bsm:hasAltitude] — Current altitude of the Object
